programme.title: Capricorn One

programme.desc: An electrician (Richard Hatch), a TV newswoman (Kay Lenz) and a mad scientist enter a dimension ruled by a warlord (John Saxon).
programme.title: Prisoners of the Lost Universe

programme.desc: Horrible old movies hosted by Dr. Paul Bearer direct from his home, the Tenement Castle.
programme.title: Dr. Paul Bearer's Creature Feature

programme.desc: S02 E07 — Day of Reckoning Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.
programme.title: Bonanza

programme.desc: A retired cat burglar (Cary Grant) sees fireworks with an American heiress (Grace Kelly) on the Riviera.
programme.title: To Catch a Thief

programme.desc: Horrible old movies hosted by Dr. Paul Bearer direct from his home, the Tenement Castle.
programme.title: Dr. Paul Bearer's Creature Feature

programme.desc: Sidekick Robin joins the caped crusader in battling evil.
programme.title: Batman and Robin

programme.desc: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square performs songs of hope, faith and inspiration; singing sacred hymns both new and old from around the world as well as uplifting selections from the American songbook.
programme.title: Music & the Spoken Word

programme.desc: A rich Virginia farmer (James Stewart) stays out of the Civil War, then joins it to protect his family.
programme.title: Shenandoah

programme.desc: The girl (Glynnis O'Connor) next door makes a teen (John Travolta) born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.
programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble

programme.desc: In a society where life ends at age 30, a law enforcement officer known as a Sandman (Michael York) flees with another 30-year-old (Jenny Agutter) when he learns his number has come up prematurely.
programme.title: Logan's Run

programme.desc: Armed with their proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls, slimy specters, and full-torso, free-roaming apparitions across New York.
programme.title: Ghostbusters

programme.desc: The history of 19th-century Western expansion, as seen through the lives of three generations of a pioneer family.
programme.title: How the West Was Won

programme.desc: Oscar-winning adaptation of the Broadway hit about an English professor (Rex Harrison) who teaches a cockney merchant (Audrey Hepburn) to be a lady.
programme.title: My Fair Lady

programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.title: Blondie

programme.desc: A Broadway star (Bette Davis) takes a young and seemingly naive aspiring actress (Anne Baxter) under her wing.
programme.title: All About Eve

programme.desc: A secret agent (Anthony Eisley) and his boss (Wandisa Leigh) check a madman's sabotage of U.S. moonshots.
programme.title: Lightning Bolt

programme.title: Earth vs. the Flying Saucers

programme.desc: S01 E92 — Rooftop Nibble Officers try to stop a motorcyclist after he weaves in and out of lanes and has no plate on his bike; officers pose as drug buyers and catch a man dealing drugs.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E93 — Mobile Shoe Shine Officers search a man who they have just pulled over, but he takes off on foot; officers find a man who just broke into a house very paranoid, on drugs and claiming someone is out to kill his family and rape his daughter.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E94 — Not Feelin' So Hot Officers see a vehicle hit a biker and immediately respond to the accident; a boyfriend assaults his girlfriend and her family and is taken into custody.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E95 — Bad Car Day Cops chase after an automobile that ran a stop sign, the suspect eventually hits another car and is arrested for driving without a license and drug possession; a female is arrested when marijuana and cocaine are found in her car.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E96 — Euro Car, American Thief A man hits a pedestrian and runs but is caught, tasered, and faces many charges including resisting arrest, hit-and-run, and driving without a license; cops arrest a man for stealing a Porsche.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E97 — Identity Thieves Cops pull over a motorcyclist who refuses to stop at a traffic signal; cops respond to a fight that breaks out in a nearby parking lot.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E98 — Male Fails Several armed men at a nearby home are arrested for assaulting people and attempting to run from cops; cops find a busted-in window of a car with a man in the front seat who claims it's his car.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E99 — Unlikely Stories Officers get a call about a man kicking out car windows; a male is arrested for attempting to steal a car at a strip mall; officers respond to a fight at a local residence.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.desc: S01 E100 — Suspect Takes a Dip A man who is out on bond for grand theft auto is arrested again for trying to steal a car; two men are arrested for threatening a woman when she sees them beating up her neighbor.
programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.title: Cops Reloaded

programme.title: Cops Reloaded
